newsitem.title: USA: Mechanics sees Q2 gain, adds to reserve.
newsitem.headline: Mechanics sees Q2 gain, adds to reserve.

text.p: Mechanics Savings Bank said on Tuesday it plans to recognize its full deferred tax asset in the second quarter, resulting in a gain of $10.2 million or approximately $2.00 per share for the quarter ending June 30, 1997.
Projections for the second half of 1997 and for 1998 indicate continued profitability sufficient to recognize the full deferred tax asset at the present time, Mechanics said.
Mechanics said it also will increase its loan loss reserve to about $14 million, as of June 30, 1997. The figure of the previous loan loss reserve was not immediately available.
The higher reserve brings it in line with banks of its peer group in New England, Mechanics Savings said.
A Mechanics spokeswoman said the company has not yet computed the over all effect from increasing the loan loss reserve and the gain, since the quarter has not yet ended.
